description: Source code for hiredis asynchronous Redis client implementation, including connection management, callback handling, and pub/sub support.

methods.name: redisAsyncInitialize
methods.description: Initializes a redisAsyncContext structure, setting up callback dictionaries and internal state.

methods.name: __redisAsyncCopyError
methods.description: Copies error information from redisContext to redisAsyncContext.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnectWithOptions
methods.description: Establishes an asynchronous Redis connection with specified options.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnect
methods.description: Establishes an asynchronous Redis connection to given IP and port.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnectBind
methods.description: Connects to Redis with a source address binding.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnectBindWithReuse
methods.description: Connects to Redis with address reuse and source address binding.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnectUnix
methods.description: Connects to Redis via Unix socket asynchronously.

methods.name: redisAsyncSetConnectCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for connection establishment.

methods.name: redisAsyncSetDisconnectCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for disconnection events.

methods.name: __redisPushCallback
methods.description: Adds a callback to the callback list.

methods.name: __redisShiftCallback
methods.description: Removes and retrieves the oldest callback from the list.

methods.name: __redisRunCallback
methods.description: Executes a callback with a reply.

methods.name: __redisRunPushCallback
methods.description: Executes the push callback with a reply.

methods.name: __redisAsyncFree
methods.description: Frees the redisAsyncContext, executing pending callbacks and cleaning up.

methods.name: __redisAsyncDisconnect
methods.description: Performs a clean disconnection, cleaning up callbacks and state.

methods.name: redisAsyncDisconnect
methods.description: Initiates disconnection, deferring cleanup if called during callbacks.

methods.name: __redisGetSubscribeCallback
methods.description: Handles pub/sub reply messages, updating subscription state.

methods.name: redisProcessCallbacks
methods.description: Processes incoming replies and dispatches callbacks, handling pub/sub and errors.

methods.name: __redisAsyncHandleConnect
methods.description: Handles the socket connection status, calling callbacks on success or failure.

methods.name: redisAsyncRead
methods.description: Reads data from socket and processes replies.

methods.name: redisAsyncHandleRead
methods.description: Called when socket is readable, triggers read and callback processing.

methods.name: redisAsyncWrite
methods.description: Writes data to socket, scheduling further writes if needed.

methods.name: redisAsyncHandleWrite
methods.description: Called when socket is writable, triggers write operations.

methods.name: redisAsyncHandleTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events, triggering callbacks and disconnects.

methods.name: nextArgument
methods.description: Parses the next argument from a Redis command string.

methods.name: __redisAsyncCommand
methods.description: Formats and sends a command, registering callback.

methods.name: redisvAsyncCommand
methods.description: Formats a command with va_list and sends it.

methods.name: redisAsyncCommand
methods.description: Formats a command with variadic arguments and sends it.

methods.name: redisAsyncCommandArgv
methods.description: Sends a command with argument vector.

methods.name: redisAsyncFormattedCommand
methods.description: Sends a pre-formatted command.

methods.name: redisAsyncSetPushCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for push messages.

methods.name: redisAsyncSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets command timeout for the async context.
